propositions: Project-specific code-review criteria merge successfully into the overlay but never execute end to end, creating a silent failure indistinguishable from no issues found.
The code-review runtime must execute activated project criteria exactly once per review using the plan-review dynamic fan-in pattern with PROJECT_FAN_IN_STEP_ID as a stateless round-a discriminator.
Logical project criterion ids must map to sanitized physical prompt ids (code-review-project-* with dots replaced by dashes) when resolving repository assets.
Activated missing or malformed project prompt/eval assets must raise a located LLMError before model execution rather than silently skipping.
Pass 3 must apply repository-effective routing (threshold, blocking posture, nit-suppression) for project criteria without invoking an LLM.
The criteria eval CLI entry point must accept logical activated code-review project ids, reject ambiguous or inactive ids, and dispatch diff cases through _run_code_review_case.
